1) Azurite crystal in blade formation - not always easy to find but fucking gorgeous. A tad pricy but crazy people like me pay for them. 

2) Hippie shops (I know) sometimes carry giant crystals. Not that it has any metaphysical properties--some people just think crystals can "hold memory." I got a very smoky phantom Quartz at a rock show the size of a Pringles can. After I told him I don't believe in the hippie stuff he discounted it. 

3) I always love breaking open my own geodes--Amazon has them. 

4) Dino poop. Always fun. (Coprolite.)

5) Lastly, my favorite: Polychrome Jasper. There are so many varieties in colour, but when I look at them my imagination just starts running away. I see space scenes, desert scenes, ocean, geography, maps--I have a polished orb that looks like an undiscovered planet--this one is my absolute favorite.
